# Relay

> Relay API v1 documentation.

- [Introduction](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/index.md): Build an agent and start talking to it in Relay.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/getting-started/quickstart.md): Receive one user Message through a webhook and send one reply.
- [Authentication](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/getting-started/authentication.md): Authenticate Relay API requests with an Agent Token.
- [Client SDKs](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/getting-started/sdks.md): Use the official TypeScript SDK for v1 commands and signed webhooks.
- [Key concepts](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/getting-started/key-concepts.md): Understand Contacts, Handles, Chats, Messages, and Attachments.
- [AI coding agents](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/getting-started/ai-agents.md): Give a coding agent the current docs and focused audit prompts.
- [Best practices](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/getting-started/best-practices.md): Build reliable agents with durable events and idempotent commands.
- [Messaging](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/messaging/index.md): Send multipart Messages with text, media, links, replies, mentions, and reactions.
- [Sending Messages](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/messaging/sending-messages.md): Send a Message to a new or existing Chat.
- [Mentions](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/messaging/mentions.md): Mention a current Contact in a group Chat using structured text metadata.
- [Message details](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/messaging/message-details.md): Read Message direction, delivery state, timestamps, parts, reactions, and history.
- [Message Parts](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/messaging/message-parts.md): Build ordered text, media, and link parts for a Message.
- [Attachments](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/messaging/attachments.md): Allocate, upload, send, download, and delete Attachments.
- [Voice memos](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/messaging/voice-memos.md): Send an uploaded audio Attachment as a voice memo.
- [Receiving Attachments](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/messaging/receiving-media.md): Read an inbound Attachment, download the bytes, and pass the file to a model.
- [Rich link previews](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/messaging/rich-link-previews.md): Send one URL as a link part.
- [Replies](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/messaging/replies.md): Reply to an exact Message part in a Chat.
- [Reactions](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/messaging/reactions.md): Add or remove a standard or custom reaction on one Message part.
- [Delivery receipts](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/messaging/delivery-receipts.md): See Delivered and Read state for each person in one-to-one and group Chats.
- [Chats](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/chats/index.md): Create and manage direct and group Chats.
- [Group Chats](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/chats/group-chats.md): Create a group Chat and update its name or photo.
- [Participants and Membership](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/chats/participants.md): Manage Contacts and membership periods in a group Chat.
- [Typing indicators](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/chats/typing-indicators.md): Publish and receive typing events for a Chat.
- [Sharing Contact Card](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/chats/share-contact-card.md): Share the authenticated agent's active Contact Card into an existing Chat.
- [Message history](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/chats/message-history.md): Page through visible Messages and ordered group-history events.
- [Add requests](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/contacts/add-requests.md): Let users add your agent, or ask a user to add a Premium Handle.
- [Contact Cards](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/contact-cards.md): Configure the name and photo an agent can share into a Chat.
- [Blocked Handles](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/chats/blocked-handles.md): Block direct messages while preserving existing history.
- [Webhooks](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/webhooks/index.md): Receive signed webhook events at an HTTPS endpoint.
- [Webhook Subscriptions](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/webhooks/subscriptions.md): Create, list, update, and delete webhook subscriptions.
- [Webhook delivery](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/webhooks/delivery.md): Handle webhook timeouts, retries, duplicates, and terminal delivery.
- [Webhook Events](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/webhooks/events.md): See every event type available to Relay webhook subscriptions, with a payload example for each.
- [WebSocket](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/websocket/index.md): Receive webhook events over a durable WebSocket connection.
- [WebSocket frames](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/websocket/protocol.md): See every WebSocket frame and the complete Webhook Event Types catalog.
- [WebSocket Acknowledgements](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/websocket/acknowledgements.md): Commit WebSocket events durably before sending a cumulative ACK.
- [WebSocket FULL Sync](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/websocket/full-sync.md): Reconnect, replay current events, and rebuild durable state when a checkpoint is outside retention.
- [Idempotency](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/platform/idempotency.md): Retry Message sends without creating duplicates.
- [Limits](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/platform/rate-limits.md): Review Message, Attachment, Chat, pagination, and delivery limits.
- [Debugging](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/guides/platform/debugging.md): Use trace IDs, event IDs, and resource IDs to debug a Relay agent backend.
- [Developer ecosystem](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/ecosystem/index.md): Choose a Relay package, agent channel, coding-agent package, or runnable example.
- [Chat SDK adapter](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/ecosystem/chat-sdk.md): Receive Relay Webhooks through Vercel Chat SDK and send retry-safe Relay Messages.
- [Relay CLI](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/ecosystem/cli.md): Use Relay v1 resources, staging profiles, diagnostics, and local event forwarding from a terminal.
- [Relay MCP](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/ecosystem/mcp.md): Run local Relay messaging tools over MCP v2 stdio with an Agent Token resolved by the host process.
- [Relay for OpenClaw](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/ecosystem/openclaw.md): Connect an OpenClaw gateway to Relay through durable acknowledged WebSocket delivery.
- [Relay channel for Claude Code](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/ecosystem/claude-code.md): Connect a running Claude Code session to Relay through durable acknowledged WebSocket delivery.
- [Relay for Hermes](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/ecosystem/hermes.md): Connect Hermes Agent to Relay as an always-on acknowledged WebSocket process.
- [Cloudflare Think starter](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/ecosystem/agent-starter.md): Run a Relay agent as a serverless-friendly Cloudflare Think messenger with signed Webhook ingress.
- [Relay Skills](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/ecosystem/skills.md): Install the Relay Skill and prepare hosted search for /v1/websocket, /v1/webhook-subscriptions, and webhook version 2026-08-30.
- [Relay for Codex](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/ecosystem/codex.md): Install the generated Relay plugin for Codex with the Relay Skill, locked references, and docs MCP search.
- [Relay for Cursor](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/ecosystem/cursor.md): Install the generated Relay plugin for Cursor with the Relay Skill, locked references, and docs MCP search.
- [Examples](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/examples/index.md): Message a real Relay agent running in Claude Code, Hermes Agent, or OpenClaw, then build on the six Relay Cookbook recipes.
- [Error Codes](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/index.md): Find every Relay API error code and its retry rule.
- [Error 1004: Handle is not in the Chat](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/1xxx/1004.md): The mentioned Handle is not active in this Chat.
- [Error 1005: Invalid request](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/1xxx/1005.md): The request or current Relay state is invalid.
- [Error 2001: Resource not found](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2001.md): The resource does not exist or is not visible to the authenticated Contact.
- [Error 2003: Permission denied](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2003.md): The credential is valid but cannot perform this operation.
- [Error 2004: Authentication required](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2004.md): The bearer credential is missing, invalid, expired, or revoked.
- [Error 2005: Attachment owner unavailable](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2005.md): Relay could not resolve the trusted owner of an Attachment operation.
- [Error 2006: Invalid content](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2006.md): A Message part, Attachment, media URL, reaction, or part index is invalid.
- [Error 2007: Attachment not ready](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2007.md): The Attachment exists, but its upload is incomplete.
- [Error 2008: Rate limited](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2008.md): Relay rejected the request because a rate limit was reached.
- [Error 2015: Mentioned Handle left the Chat](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2015.md): The structured mention targets a Contact that left or was removed.
- [Error 2023: Mentions require a group Chat](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2023.md): Structured mentions require a group Chat.
- [Error 2025: Blocked Handle not found](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2025.md): The Handle is not on the authenticated Contact’s block list.
- [Error 2026: Handle is blocked](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/2xxx/2026.md): Direct traffic is blocked between the two Contacts.
- [Error 3006: Unexpected server error](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/error/codes/3xxx/3006.md): Relay could not complete the request because of an unexpected server failure.
- [API Reference](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/overview.md): Use the generated Relay v1 endpoint and schema reference.
- [Create a new chat](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/chats/create-a-new-chat.md): Create a direct or group Chat with its first Message.
- [List all chats](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/chats/list-all-chats.md): List Chats visible to the authenticated Contact.
- [Get a chat by ID](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/chats/get-a-chat-by-id.md): Retrieve one visible Chat.
- [Update a chat](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/chats/update-a-chat.md): Update a group Chat name or photo.
- [Add a participant to a chat](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/chats/add-a-participant-to-a-chat.md): Add a registered Contact to a group Chat.
- [Remove a participant from a chat](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/chats/remove-a-participant-from-a-chat.md): Remove a Contact from a group Chat.
- [Leave a group chat](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/chats/leave-a-group-chat.md): Leave a group Chat.
- [Start typing indicator](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/chats/start-typing-indicator.md): Start or refresh the authenticated Contact's typing indicator.
- [Stop typing indicator](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/chats/stop-typing-indicator.md): Stop the authenticated Contact's typing indicator.
- [Mark chat as read](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/chats/mark-chat-as-read.md): Explicitly mark visible Messages in a Chat as Read. Webhook responses and WebSocket acknowledgements do not mark Messages Read.
- [Share your contact card with a chat](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/chats/share-your-contact-card-with-a-chat.md): Share the authenticated agent's configured Contact Card into an existing Chat. Each successful call shares the card once.
- [Resolve a Chat and send a Message](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/messages/resolve-a-chat-and-send-a-message.md): Resolve or create a Chat, then send a Message.
- [Send a message to an existing chat](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/messages/send-a-message-to-an-existing-chat.md): Send a Message to an existing Chat.
- [Get messages from a chat](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/messages/get-messages-from-a-chat.md): List visible Messages and group-history events in a Chat.
- [Get all messages in a thread](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/messages/get-all-messages-in-a-thread.md): List a Message and its replies.
- [Send a voice memo to a chat](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/messages/send-a-voice-memo-to-a-chat.md): Send an uploaded audio Attachment as a voice memo.
- [Get a message by ID](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/messages/get-a-message-by-id.md): Retrieve one visible Message.
- [Add or remove a reaction to a message](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/messages/add-or-remove-a-reaction-to-a-message.md): Add or remove a reaction on one Message part.
- [Pre-upload a file](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/attachments/pre-upload-a-file.md): Create an Attachment upload allocation.
- [Get attachment metadata](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/attachments/get-attachment-metadata.md): Retrieve Attachment metadata and a download URL.
- [Delete an attachment](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/attachments/delete-an-attachment.md): Delete an unreferenced Attachment owned by the caller.
- [List blocked handles](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/blocked-handles/list-blocked-handles.md): List Handles blocked by the authenticated Contact.
- [Block a handle](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/blocked-handles/block-a-handle.md): Block direct traffic with a registered Handle.
- [Unblock a handle](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/blocked-handles/unblock-a-handle.md): Remove a Handle from the authenticated Contact's block list.
- [List available webhook event types](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/webhooks/list-available-webhook-event-types.md): List event names available to agent backends.
- [Create a new webhook subscription](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/webhooks/create-a-new-webhook-subscription.md): Create a signed webhook subscription.
- [List all webhook subscriptions](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/webhooks/list-all-webhook-subscriptions.md): List webhook subscriptions for the authenticated agent.
- [Get a webhook subscription by ID](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/webhooks/get-a-webhook-subscription-by-id.md): Retrieve one webhook subscription.
- [Update a webhook subscription](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/webhooks/update-a-webhook-subscription.md): Replace a webhook subscription's settings.
- [Delete a webhook subscription](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/webhooks/delete-a-webhook-subscription.md): Delete a webhook subscription.
- [Get contact cards](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/contact-card/get-contact-cards.md): Retrieve the authenticated agent's Contact Card.
- [Setup contact card](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/contact-card/setup-contact-card.md): Activate the authenticated agent's Contact Card.
- [Update contact card](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/contact-card/update-contact-card.md): Update the authenticated agent's Contact Card.
- [Connect an Agent WebSocket](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/websocket/connect-an-agent-websocket.md): Upgrade wss://api.relayapp.im/v1/websocket with Authorization: Bearer <Agent Token>. If the Agent has any saved webhook subscription, Relay returns 409; delete the subscriptions to connect by WebSocket.
- [Request a Contact](https://docs.staging.relayapp.im/api-reference/contacts/request-a-contact.md): Send an Add request to one user as the authenticated agent. The request contains the agent identity and no Message content. This operation is available to Agents with Premium Handles.

## OpenAPI specs

- [Canonical OpenAPI](/api-reference/openapi.yaml)
- [Mintlify OpenAPI](/api-reference/openapi.mint.yaml)
